title: Build only the index paths the product needs
description: Choose a field contract and a Lucene field recipe. The lab shows which postings, stored values, and doc values are created, and which product questions remain impossible.

scenarios.label: Search and display a title
scenarios.detail: Find title words and phrases, then return the original title in results.

scenarios.label: Search, display, and sort a title
scenarios.detail: Keep relevance search while adding a normalized alphabetical sort key.

scenarios.label: Filter and sort a SKU
scenarios.detail: Treat an application-generated identifier as one exact value.

scenarios.label: Filter and sort a price
scenarios.detail: Use an integer amount for exact matches, ranges, ordering, and display.

scenarios.label: Search body text without returning it
scenarios.detail: Search words and phrases, but retrieve the document from another store.
scenarios.sample: Readers reopen a point-in-time index view.

recipes.label: TextField, not stored
recipes.detail: Tokenized full-text search with positions; the original value is not returned.

structures.label: Postings + positions
structures.role: Find analyzed terms and preserve phrase order.

recipes.label: TextField, stored
recipes.detail: Full-text search plus retrieval of the original field value.

structures.label: Postings + positions
structures.role: Find analyzed terms and preserve phrase order.

structures.label: Stored value
structures.role: Return the original title with a search hit.

recipes.label: TextField + sorted doc values
recipes.detail: Use one analyzed path for relevance and one normalized value for ordering.

structures.label: Sorted doc values
structures.role: Read one normalized sort value per document.

recipes.label: StringField + sorted doc values
recipes.detail: Index the identifier as one term, retain it, and add a column-style sort path.

structures.label: Stored value
structures.role: Return the identifier with the hit.

recipes.label: IntField, stored
recipes.detail: Use Lucene's typed integer field for exact/range queries, sorting, and retrieval.

structures.label: Stored value
structures.role: Return the integer with the hit.

recipes.label: StoredField only
recipes.detail: Return a value by document ID without making that field searchable or sortable.

structures.label: Stored value
structures.role: Return the value after another field finds the document.
